**Fix:** commit `f462a28bf6f97d3a1c963e362b79c31b56f69bd4` in `openmrs-esm-admin-tools`, merged as PR #376. Its title is "(fix) O3-5993: Reports app shows literal {parameters} instead of the missing parameter names". The diff changes one string: the default message went from `{parameters}` to `{{parameters}}`. The app's i18n interpolation only substitutes double-brace placeholders, so the single-brace form was shown literally.

**Implementing line:** `openmrs-esm-admin-tools/packages/esm-reports-app/src/components/reports-data-overview.component.tsx:84`. The `t('missingParameters', ...)` call on line 84 builds the snackbar subtitle, and line 85 passes `parameters: missingParameters.join(', ')` to fill it. The names come from lines 76–78, which filter the report's required parameters with no value and map them to `param.label`.

**Supporting evidence:**
- The same key in the English source catalogue, `openmrs-esm-admin-tools/packages/esm-reports-app/translations/en.json:34`, already uses `{{parameters}}`.
- The commit body says only `en.json` is maintained in this repo. Other locales come from Transifex, so they pick up the corrected placeholder through sync.

I checked the change by reading the diff and the code. I did not run the reports app to confirm the snackbar text at runtime.
